## Install

In Foundry → **Add-on Modules → Install Module**, paste the manifest URL:

```
https://github.com/takaqiao/pf2e-xp-tool/releases/latest/download/module.json
```

## Compatibility

- Foundry VTT v12 ~ v14
- PF2e system
